name: Applicant Name
whatItMeans: This is the full name of the person applying for the Apathbandu scheme.
whatToEnter: Enter your full name as recorded in official identity documents.

name: Father's / Husband's Name
whatItMeans: This is the name of the applicant's father or husband for familial identification.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of your father or husband.

name: Date of Age / Birth
whatItMeans: This indicates the applicant's age or exact date of birth to verify eligibility.
whatToEnter: Enter your date of birth or current age in years.

name: Gender
whatItMeans: This specifies the gender of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Select or enter your gender (Male, Female, or Other).

name: Caste / Category
whatItMeans: This refers to the social category or caste of the applicant for administrative records.
whatToEnter: Enter your caste and select your category (SC, ST, BC, or OC).

name: Address Details
whatItMeans: This is the permanent residential address of the applicant including district and mandal.
whatToEnter: Enter your complete residential address including house number, street, village/town, mandal, and district.

name: Mobile Number
whatItMeans: This is the primary contact number of the applicant for receiving updates and verification.

name: Deceased / Accident Victim Details
whatItMeans: This provides information about the person who met with the fatal accident or emergency covered under the Apathbandu scheme.
whatToEnter: Enter the name, age, and relationship of the victim to the applicant, if applicable.

name: Details of the Accident / Incident
whatItMeans: This describes how, when, and where the accident or unfortunate incident occurred.
whatToEnter: Provide the date, time, location, and brief description of the accident.

name: FIR / Police Station Details
whatItMeans: This records the police complaint or First Information Report registered regarding the accident.
whatToEnter: Enter the FIR number, date, and name of the police station where the case was registered.

name: Bank Account Details
whatItMeans: This is the bank account information of the applicant where financial assistance or relief funds will be directly credited.
whatToEnter: Enter your bank account number, bank name, branch, and IFSC code.
